capabilities: Render a color swatch next to hex, rgb and hsl codes in Reading view and Live Preview
Copy a color code to the clipboard by clicking it
Copy a color in a chosen format via a right-click menu
Convert a color code, a selection, or all colors in a note between hex, rgb and hsl
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a privacy section (no network or clipboard reading) and documents edge cases, such as bare hex codes being read as tags and colors inside formatting or code blocks getting no swatch.
problem: Obsidian displays color codes like #ff8800 or rgb(255, 136, 0) as plain text, so you cannot see the color or copy and convert it without leaving your note.
summary: Inline color swatch renderer that shows a swatch next to color codes in notes and copies or converts them between hex, rgb and hsl.
